name: PLSC 2120E
title: Environmental Soil Science
description: Introduction to the physical, chemical, and biological properties of soils. The relationship between soils and the growth of higher plants. Impact of soils on environmental quality.
requirement_description: CHEM 1122 or CHEM 1124Q or CHEM 1127Q or CHEM 1137Q or CHEM 1147Q. May not be taken out of sequence after passing PLSC 3620.
